verbs.name: project.package_plan
verbs.description: B6 dry-run for a Cut-native portable package. The Projects > Make a copy flow and direct API both hash every referenced media source with full SHA-256, include tracks from every sequence, refuse offline/symlinked media and unsupported Motion-linked provenance, and return a content/destination/B5-evidence-bound plan_hash. It writes no package and does not mutate source project operations, assets, caches, or media. A B5 shellx-cut/media-relink-receipt/1 is optional only when no offline media was repaired; if the current project revision is a B5 grouped relink, its exact durable receipt is required. When supplied it must be immutable, journal-backed, and match the current source revision exactly.

destination.description: Existing plain local parent directory for the new <name>.cutproj package. Symlink and reparse-point destinations refuse.

name.description: Cross-platform package name: ASCII letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, or underscores; becomes <name>.cutproj.

b5_receipt.description: Optional immutable shellx-cut/media-relink-receipt/1 returned by B5 for media repaired before packaging. It is validated against the source journal but its source paths are not emitted in the package.

verbs.result: {plan:shellx-cut/portable-package-plan/1:{project_identity,project_revision,destination,name,target,target_status:'available'|'occupied',b5_receipt_sha256?,assets:[{asset,source_path,bytes,sha256,package_path}],total_source_bytes,total_package_bytes,source_file_count,unique_media_count,policy},plan_hash:'sha256:<full>'} — a dry run only; source_path is the exact canonical Unicode path of each referenced asset for review and is bound into plan_hash, but is not written into the package manifest; non-Unicode source paths refuse; target_status is current preview truth and creation rechecks without replacement; duplicate full-content media are represented once in total_package_bytes

verbs.name: project.package_create
verbs.description: B6 Pack project publication used after an explicit Projects > Make a copy confirmation or by direct API. It recomputes the supplied full-SHA-256 plan, copies only referenced media into a private same-parent stage, clears derived-cache pointers, creates a replayable Cut-native portable baseline, verifies every manifest member checksum, then atomically publishes a new destination without replacement. Linux, macOS, and Windows each use their native no-replace directory primitive; unverified targets fail closed. The source project's op log, project cache, asset paths, and media are never changed; source-local job status is the only operational record. It never searches/relinks missing media: repaired source evidence must be B5's immutable receipt.

destination.description: The same existing plain local parent directory used by project.package_plan.

name.description: The same package name used by project.package_plan.

b5_receipt.description: The same optional immutable B5 receipt supplied to project.package_plan.

verbs.result: {job_id,plan_hash,source_revision,target,status:'queued'} — poll jobs.status; successful result is {status:'published'|'published_with_warnings',destination,manifest_sha256,source_revision,file_count,bytes,warnings?}. The warning status is only possible after final publication, when a post-publication durability or private-stage cleanup warning is retained for the operator. Existing destinations, stale plan/source/B5 evidence, offline media, checksums, cancellation, and unsupported hosts fail without publishing a final package.
